pages.text: $(bold)Long-Short Blade$()$(br2)Obtaining: craft it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() — combining a Broad Blade + a Small Blade + a Tough Handle + a Tough Ring + a Bow Limb.$(br2)Features: a $(bold)dual-wield, swappable$() weapon — a $(bold)long blade in the main hand and a short blade in the off hand$(), so you fight with a blade in each hand and switch freely between their styles.

$(bold)Swapping the two blades$():$(li)press $(bold)F$() to swap the $(bold)long blade in your main hand$() with the $(bold)short blade in your off hand$()$(li)$(bold)Long blade$(): longer reach, built around the $(bold)thrust$()$(li)$(bold)Short blade$(): faster swings, and it can be $(bold)charged and thrown$()$(br2)$(bold)Fever$(): attacks build up Fever, and attack speed rises with it.$(br2)$(bold)Killing aura$(): nearby enemies keep taking damage.$(br2)Your current Fever and aura state are shown on the tooltip.
